description: Part 9 probe (design section 7 batches 1 and part of 2): JSON_OBJECT/JSON_ARRAYAGG(FORMAT JSON)/JSON_TABLE NESTED PATH both through db2 (collect) and through RUNSQLSTM SRCSTMF from the IFS using the new 'after' sh step ($HOME expanded by qsh); the IFS script is run twice, as written by the harness heredoc (CCSID 273 tag) and after iconv to UTF-8/CCSID 1208, to settle whether $ [ ] { } survive (P32); job CCSID (P03); IFS_WRITE_UTF8/IFS_READ_UTF8 (P35); 09-02b UX'..' -> CCSID 1208/1399/939/930 HEX round trips and a CHGJOB CCSID(1399) session (P39); loopback-only port responses for the ACS/Mapepire ports (P14/P40: exit code of a 3-second curl telnet:// connect to 127.0.0.1 on the PUB400 host itself, nothing else). Safety: CURSET first, everything created in &LIB with explicit qualification; the private library is never written.

steps.label: CURSET
steps.cmd: CHGCURLIB CURLIB(&LIB)

steps.label: MKCUR
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE &LIB/VFYCUR (TAG VARCHAR(40), ORD INT, LIB VARCHAR(20), TYPE VARCHAR(10))') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: REC0
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFYCUR SELECT ''A0-AFTER-CHGCURLIB'', ORDINAL_POSITION, SCHEMA_NAME, TYPE FROM QSYS2.LIBRARY_LIST_INFO') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: MKJP
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE &LIB/VFYJP (LBL VARCHAR(30), VAL VARCHAR(200))') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: JP0
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFYJP SELECT ''JOB-CCSID-273JOB'', HEX(CAST(UX''3042'' AS VARCHAR(10) CCSID 1208)) FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: JOBCC
steps.cmd: CHGJOB CCSID(1399)

steps.label: JP1
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFYJP SELECT ''JOB1399-U1208'', HEX(CAST(UX''3042'' AS VARCHAR(10) CCSID 1208)) FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: JP2
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFYJP SELECT ''JOB1399-U1399'', HEX(CAST(UX''3042'' AS VARCHAR(10) CCSID 1399)) FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: JP3
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFYJP SELECT ''JOB1399-CCSID'', CHAR(CCSID) FROM TABLE(QSYS2.ACTIVE_JOB_INFO(JOB_NAME_FILTER => ''*'')) X') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: RUN1
steps.cmd: system "RUNSQLSTM SRCSTMF('$HOME/vfy/part09-01-02-json/probe.sql') COMMIT(*NONE) NAMING(*SQL) DFTRDBCOL(&LIB) ERRLVL(40)" 2>&1; ls -S $HOME/vfy/part09-01-02-json/probe.sql 2>&1

steps.label: CONV
steps.cmd: iconv -f IBM-273 -t UTF-8 $HOME/vfy/part09-01-02-json/probe8.sql > $HOME/vfy/part09-01-02-json/probe8u.sql 2>&1; echo iconv-exit=$?; setccsid 1208 $HOME/vfy/part09-01-02-json/probe8u.sql; ls -S $HOME/vfy/part09-01-02-json/probe8.sql $HOME/vfy/part09-01-02-json/probe8u.sql 2>&1; od -x $HOME/vfy/part09-01-02-json/probe8u.sql | head -3

steps.label: RUN2
steps.cmd: system "RUNSQLSTM SRCSTMF('$HOME/vfy/part09-01-02-json/probe8u.sql') COMMIT(*NONE) NAMING(*SQL) DFTRDBCOL(&LIB) ERRLVL(40)" 2>&1

steps.label: RUNLESSON
steps.cmd: system "RUNSQLSTM SRCSTMF('$HOME/vfy/part09-01-02-json/09-02-json.sql') COMMIT(*NONE) NAMING(*SQL) DFTRDBCOL(&LIB) ERRLVL(40) OUTPUT(*PRINT)" 2>&1

steps.label: IFSW
steps.cmd: db2 "CALL QSYS2.IFS_WRITE_UTF8(PATH_NAME => '$HOME/vfy/part09-01-02-json/w.json', LINE => '{\"a\":1}', OVERWRITE => 'REPLACE', END_OF_LINE => 'NONE')" 2>&1; ls -S $HOME/vfy/part09-01-02-json/w.json 2>&1; od -c $HOME/vfy/part09-01-02-json/w.json 2>&1 | head -3

steps.label: IFSR
steps.cmd: db2 "SELECT * FROM TABLE(QSYS2.IFS_READ_UTF8(PATH_NAME => '$HOME/vfy/part09-01-02-json/w.json'))" 2>&1 | head -8

steps.label: IFSW2
steps.cmd: db2 "CALL QSYS2.IFS_WRITE_UTF8(PATH_NAME => '$HOME/vfy/part09-01-02-json/w2.txt', LINE => UX'3042', OVERWRITE => 'REPLACE', END_OF_LINE => 'NONE')" 2>&1; ls -S $HOME/vfy/part09-01-02-json/w2.txt 2>&1; od -x $HOME/vfy/part09-01-02-json/w2.txt 2>&1 | head -3

steps.sql: SELECT TAG, ORD, LIB, TYPE FROM &LIB/VFYCUR ORDER BY TAG, ORD

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('orderNo': M.JUNO, 'orderDate': M.JUDATE, 'lines': (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('line': D.JULINE, 'product': D.JUSHO, 'qty': D.JUSU, 'unitPrice': D.JUTNK) ORDER BY D.JULINE) FROM &LIB.JUCHUD D WHERE D.JUNO = M.JUNO) FORMAT JSON) AS ORDER_JSON FROM &LIB.JUCHUM M WHERE M.JUNO = 'J00001'

WITH DOCS AS (SELECT M.JUNO, JSON_OBJECT('orderNo': M.JUNO, 'lines': (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('line': D.JULINE, 'product': D.JUSHO, 'qty': D.JUSU) ORDER BY D.JULINE) FROM &LIB.JUCHUD D WHERE D.JUNO = M.JUNO) FORMAT JSON) AS DOC FROM &LIB.JUCHUM M) SELECT X.JUNO, T.LINE_NO, T.PRODUCT, T.QTY FROM DOCS X, JSON_TABLE(X.DOC, 'lax $' COLUMNS(NESTED PATH 'lax $.lines[*]' COLUMNS(LINE_NO INT PATH 'lax $.line', PRODUCT CHAR(6) PATH 'lax $.product', QTY INT PATH 'lax $.qty'))) AS T ORDER BY X.JUNO, T.LINE_NO

SELECT HEX(CAST(UX'3042' AS VARCHAR(10) CCSID 1208)) AS U1208, HEX(CAST(UX'3042' AS VARCHAR(10) CCSID 1399)) AS U1399, HEX(CAST(UX'3042' AS VARCHAR(10) CCSID 939)) AS U939, HEX(CAST(UX'3042' AS VARCHAR(10) CCSID 930)) AS U930 FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1

SELECT HEX(CAST(X'E38182' AS VARCHAR(3) CCSID 1208)) AS X_AS_1208, HEX(CAST(CAST(X'E38182' AS VARCHAR(3) FOR BIT DATA) AS VARCHAR(3) CCSID 1208)) AS BITDATA_CAST, HEX(GX'0E30420F') AS GX_TRY FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1
SELECT HEX(CAST(UX'3042' AS GRAPHIC(1) CCSID 1200)) AS G1200, HEX(CAST(UX'3042' AS CHAR(1) CCSID 1399)) AS TRUNC1399 FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1
